correctness.rationale: For degree N polynomial, H_{bar psi} annihilates z^j for j>=N, so H*H range is in E_N. Normalized kernels k_a tend weakly to zero as |a|->1; compact H sends them to 0 in norm, hence SRKT equality attains an interior norming kernel. Rayleigh quotient makes it an eigenvector in E_N, forcing a=0 since k_a for a!=0 has infinite tail. The equations for k_0=1 being top eigenvector force all positive-lag autocorrelations of c_1..c_N zero. The widest support lag s-r contributes only c_s conjugate(c_r), a contradiction unless one coefficient; monomial case directly norming. No numerical experiment necessary.
